lines.text: Every fight in my game should feel like this. One hit from losing.
But close fights don't happen by accident.
So before I film anything, I run it in the simulator. Six highlanders... the marshal walks it. Nine... he falls.
Eight. Ten percent left. That's the fight.
Tank. Titan. Landship. Every duel, tuned until it ends on a sliver.
So... which unit should I put to the test next?
